# Introduction

This document displays the spatial plots of a variety of variables for each of the 5 CCUH cities.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Libraries and theming."

# Spatial Libraries
library("arrow")
library("geoarrow")
library("sf")
library("leaflet")

# General Libraries
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
library("patchwork")
library("lubridate")
library("glue")

# ggplot2 theming
theme_set(theme_classic())
theme_update(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             strip.background = element_blank(),
             strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
             axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust=1))
```

## Neighborhood Level Variables
```{r}
#| code-summary: "Read in neighborhood level variables."

# Colored Shape Plots -----------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(here("1-data", "merged_data_by_age.csv"))

df_nbhd_meta <- df |> 
  filter(!(city_name %in% c("Belo Horizonte", "Campinas"))) |>
  summarize(across(c(city_name, iso2, pct_green, pct_primary, pop_density), first),
            nbhd_death = sum(death),
            `nbhd_death_<65` = sum(death * (age_category == "<65")), 
            `nbhd_death_65+` = sum(death * (age_category == "65+")), .by = nbhd_geoid) |> 
  mutate(nbhd_death_ratio = `nbhd_death_65+`/`nbhd_death_<65`,
         log_pop_density = log(pop_density),
         log_nbhd_death = log(nbhd_death))

# Cities of interest
city_names <- unique(df$city_name)

# Countries of interest
country_names <- unique(df$iso2)
```

## Spatial Boundaries
```{r}
#| code-summary: "Read in spatial boundaries."


# Pennsylvania ------------------------------------------------------------
phl_sf <- "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze//schema_ccuh_phl_metro_nbhd/schema_ccuh_phl_metro_nbhd__nad83.parquet" %>%
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf()

# SALURBAL Cities ---------------------------------------------------------

# Connect to API
df_salurbal_nbhd <- "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/salurbal_boundaries__v1/salurbal_boundaries_v1.parquet" %>% 
  arrow::open_dataset() |> 
  sf::st_as_sf()

# Create city specific sf object
rio_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "102190"), geo == "l2_5") |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Rio de Janiero")
sao_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "102248"), geo == "l2_5") |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Sao Paulo")
gua_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "203102"), geo == "l2")   |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Guatemala City")
pan_sf <- df_salurbal_nbhd |> filter(str_detect(geoid, "206101"), geo == "l2")   |> mutate(nbhd_geoid = geoid, city_name = "Panama City")

```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Spatial boundary plots."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

basic_plots <- list(
  phl_sf |> ggplot() + geom_sf() + labs(title = "Philadelphia PA Metro"), 
  rio_sf |> ggplot() + geom_sf() + labs(title = "Rio de Janiero"),
  sao_sf |> ggplot() + geom_sf() + labs(title = "Sao Paulo"),
  gua_sf |> ggplot() + geom_sf() + labs(title = "Guatemala City"),
  pan_sf |> ggplot() + geom_sf() + labs(title = "Panama City")
)

wrap_plots(basic_plots)
```

# Spatial Plots
```{r}
#| code-summary: "Generate spatial plots."

spatial_plot <- function(sf, variable, color_direction = 1) {
  fill_range <- range(df_nbhd_meta[[variable]])
  city_name <- sf$city_name
  
  sf |> 
    left_join(df_nbhd_meta, by = "nbhd_geoid") |> 
    ggplot(aes(fill = !!sym(variable))) +
    geom_sf() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = fill_range, direction = color_direction) +
    labs(title = city_name)
}

create_plots <- function(variable, color_direction = 1) {
  spatial_plot(phl_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(rio_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(sao_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(gua_sf, variable, color_direction) + 
    spatial_plot(pan_sf, variable, color_direction) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") 
}
```

## Percent Greenspace
```{r}
#| code-summary: "Percent Greenspace"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

create_plots("pct_green")   & labs(fill = "Greenspace %")
```

## Percent of Population that Finish Primary School
```{r}
#| code-summary: "Percent Primary"

#| fig-height: 8

create_plots("pct_primary") & labs(fill = "Completed Primary\nEducation %")

```
